page_title: WER 4-0 MAI | Werder Bremen v Mainz 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The game is interrupted. Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+2' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+2' Mainz are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. It will be a corner kick for Mainz.
90+1' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
86' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Mitchell Weiser will be replaced by Leon Opitz (Werder Bremen).
85' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' The Mainz players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
84' Dominik Kohr will be replaced by Merveille Papela (Mainz).
83' 4 - 0 Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.

82' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Justin Njinmah plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.
81' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Schroder blows for a foul.
79' 49:51 – the ratio of ball possession.
78' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
77' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
76' Here comes a substitution. Jens Stage is given a rest as he is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
76' Here is a change. Christian Gross is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen).
76' It will be a substitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Dawid Kownacki walks off.
74' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) is able to continue to play.
73' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
71' Mainz are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The linesman makes the right call and Mainz will have a corner.
70' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
69' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Schroder blows for a foul.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Marco Richter (Mainz) is replacing Jae-Sung Lee.
67' Bo Svensson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Krauss (Mainz) replacing Phillipp Mwene.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Nelson Weiper (Mainz) coming on for Brajan Gruda.
65' The game has begun to heat up. Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
63' Robert Schroder blows his whistle and signals a foul after Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) brought his opponent down.
62' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
60' Anthony Caci (Mainz) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Schroder blows for a foul.
58' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
56' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' Mainz keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Schroder had an easy-decision to make.
53' 2 - 0 Goal! Mitchell Weiser gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the top right corner. 2:0.
49' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Karim Onisiwo, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
47' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Bo Svensson probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Andreas Hanche-Olsen. He is replaced by Stefan Bell (Mainz).
46' The whistle blows and Robert Schroder starts the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) jumps into a tackle and Robert Schroder signals a foul.
45+2' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) is penalised for a foul. Robert Schroder had a clear view and blows his whistle.
44' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

44' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
42' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

39' A sweet pass finds Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Robin Zentner is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
36' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
33' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
31' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
29' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) makes a strong challenge and Robert Schroder blows for a foul.

27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) beautifully controls an overhit pass, beats an opponent but hits a weak shot at goal that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
26' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared.

26' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Jiri Pavlenka stops the ball from going into the top left corner. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
23' Ole Werner is forced to make a change. Marvin Ducksch is unable to continue due to injury, Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) comes on.
22' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
22' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
20' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' The game is interrupted now, Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Robert Schroder stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
13' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
12' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) commits a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Mainz are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Corner kick. Mainz will have an opportunity.
10' A yellow card is awarded to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen).

8' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Robin Zentner makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
8' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

8' Werder Bremen play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.

6' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
5' It looks like Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Robert Schroder won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Robin Zentner into the bottom right corner.
3' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is going to take the penalty!
2' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
1' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' The match has just started.
Mainz will kick-off.
Robert Schroder will referee today's match.
